description: Publicly shared daily postcards. Only add photos and notes explicitly approved for public sharing. Photos should use committed repository-relative URLs, e.g. photos/2026-11-03-amsterdam.jpg. Do not publish private cabin or exact real-time location.

entries.note: Our Grand European Adventure begins! Four travelers, one unforgettable journey. Next stop: London, then Amsterdam, where our Viking adventure awaits!
entries.photo_alt: Four travelers smiling together at Seattle airport before their flight to Europe.

entries.note: A fun stop at the famous Heineken Experience! Enjoying the sights, history, and a little Dutch brewing tradition before our Viking river cruise begins.
entries.photo_alt: Our group visiting the Heineken Experience in Amsterdam.

entries.note: We enjoyed a lovely morning exploring Amsterdam one last time, wandering the streets and soaking up the sights before boarding our transfer to the ship. After several wonderful days discovering the city, it was exciting to finally arrive at our Viking longship and begin the next chapter of our European adventure. Of course, we had to capture a picture together outside our home on the river for the next several days. Let the cruising begin!
entries.photo_alt: Our group outside our Viking river cruise ship on embarkation day.

entries.note: Today was another wonderful day on our Viking adventure! We visited the famous Windmills of Kinderdijk, a UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring 19 historic Dutch windmills. Doug and Jill made sure Washington State University was represented, proudly flying their WSU Cougar flag among the windmills. Go Cougs! Back aboard our Viking ship, we raised a glass of champagne to celebrate our adventures before our evening briefing with the activities director to hear what tomorrow has in store. Great sights, great friends, and wonderful memories. Cheers to another fantastic day in Europe!
entries.photo_alt: Our visit to Kinderdijk and its historic Dutch windmills.

entries.note: We spent the morning exploring Cologne, including its amazing cathedral. After lunch, we said goodbye to the Viking Egdir and headed to Aschaffenburg to board the Viking Vidar. Not quite the original plan, but another good day with great company!

Today we got to cruise the supposedly “uncruisable” stretch of the Rhine! We boarded a smaller boat and made our way through the Rhine Gorge, passing castle after castle perched high above the river. Beautiful scenery everywhere we looked. Pretty glad we didn't miss this part of the trip!
entries.photo_alt: Koblenz group photo with Ehrenbreitstein Fortress across the Rhine; Pfalzgrafenstein Castle near Kaub with Gutenfels Castle above.
